intent: A full-surface comparison slider with a crisp divider and keyboard control, shown with an original typographic wireframe and finished editorial cover.

layout.direction: Align two original typographic covers in an explicitly full-width 4:3 image stage. Let its 256px minimum height keep small covers legible without widening the stage beyond its card. Clip the wireframe layer from the right as the split changes. Use a crisp vertical divider, 44px handle, 12px before/after labels and a 16px caption. Keep the artwork and surrounding chrome neutral.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: The comparison enters with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: The divider follows the native value immediately. The handle has the existing 150ms hover and 100ms press response.
motion.reduced: Listen to live preference changes and immediately finish the entry without replacing the range or losing focus. Drop handle scaling under reduced motion.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: before
props.description: Decorative visual layer. Hidden from the accessibility tree; nested controls are excluded from keyboard navigation.

props.name: after
props.description: Decorative visual layer. Hidden from the accessibility tree; nested controls are excluded from keyboard navigation.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled split percentage. A controlled comparison without onChange is read-only.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep BeforeAfterProps. before and after are decorative ReactNode layers. Hide them from the accessibility tree and make their descendants inert so host controls cannot enter keyboard navigation.

Use a real native range across the image for pointer dragging, keyboard arrows, Home and End. Keep the divider and clip exactly aligned with the displayed split. Normalize non-finite percentages to 50. Clamp finite values to 0-100 and round them to whole percentages so the native range, divider, clip and announced value agree.

Uncontrolled instances own local state. Controlled instances display the host value and call onChange synchronously; a controlled value without a writer is read-only and offers no drag affordance. The host owns asynchronous work.

Use a visible compound focus ring over both light and dark artwork. Expose the native range and use explicit Canvas/CanvasText system colours in forced-colour mode. The image comparison is a full-surface native range with its visible divider; it retains the control kit hover, press, focus and target-size principles.
Keep instance-scoped caption IDs, useful comparison labels and long copy within the 320px layout.
